name: Different match pages show different news article sets
description: The Related News panel should be match-specific. Two different match pages should not show the exact same set of news articles, which would indicate shared generic content.

planSteps.description: Click on a first bracket match cell to open its match detail page
Click the Related News tab and note the title of the first news card
Click on a different bracket match (a different round or country matchup)
Verify the first news card title on the second match page is different from the first card on the first match. If both matches show identically titled news articles in the same order, the test fails.
